name: dsh-ainar-course-model
description: The AINAR course model as native DeepSeek Harness tools: sixteen read-only reads over a course workspace.

comments.assets: `widget-assets` was in `files` until 2026-09-17 and a copy of it sat in this directory. Nothing read it: the resolution happens inside `@ainar/core`, relative to where THAT package is, and the layout in which two directories above the compiled tools landed here — a compiled core under `server/` — was deleted on 2026-09-16. The one copy is `vendor/ainar/mcp/widget-assets/`; see PROVENANCE.md.
comments.core: The model itself is `@ainar/core` in ainar-node/, not a copy under server/. It is declared here so the dependency is stated where it is used, and it is ALSO a dependency of the project, because `dsh plugin add` forwards to pnpm and pnpm cannot resolve a file: spec whose absolute path contains a space — which this checkout's does. Node resolution finds the package from the dsh installation's node_modules either way.
